why_this_file_exists: The P5-retire oracle pass surfaced two defects that predate this phase. The seed-retirement slice correctly refused to fix them inside itself — both move committed baseline leaves and each owes its own R-20 population and its own oracle receipts — but the escalation lived only as commit-body prose. Prose in a commit body is exactly what the phase-boundary re-capture absorbs: the moved leaves enter the new baseline, the compare goes quiet, and nothing anywhere says a defect is still shipping. This is that escalation as a dated, gated artifact, in the idiom of the audit's acknowledged-gap list. It is closed by deleting the entry, which the gate forces the moment the defect stops reproducing.

site.fragment: applies cc_kind crowd control — setup before

defects.defect: The cc_setup fan-out interpolates the field NAME where the authored value belongs. The published citation reads 'E applies cc_kind crowd control — setup before R'; the module authored cc_kind='stun' and the resolver holds it as the atom 'cc_kind=stun'. The sibling shred and buff fan-outs interpolate their atom; this branch alone does not, so a receipt that exists to name the marker driving the edge names the field instead of the marker.

live_signature.published_sentence_contains: E applies cc_kind crowd control — setup before

defects.not_fixed_here_because: The line is pre-campaign and the string already ships in the committed coupled baseline for champions this phase never touches, so correcting it moves committed leaves as well as new ones. That is a semantic slice owing its own R-20 population, enumerated before its first src/ edit, and an oracle receipt per qualifying occurrence (R-19, R-20). Reverting the seed retirement removes neither the line nor those leaves.
defects.resolution: A named follow-on slice: interpolate the cc_kind atom the branch already tested for, so the sentence reads 'E applies cc_kind=stun — setup before R'; enumerate the qualifying population from the committed baselines before the edit; carry an oracle receipt per occurrence.

defects.defect: _Edge.sentence() wraps a recast citation that already says the same thing, so the published sentence is 'Q2 is the recast of Q — Q2 is Q's recast (recast_of atom)': one claim twice, and neither half carries the precondition. The seed's prose said the recast exists only at forty splinters; the derived sentence says nothing about when Q2 is castable, so a reader of the receipt cannot tell that the edge is conditional at all.

live_signature.published_sentence: Q2 is the recast of Q — Q2 is Q's recast (recast_of atom)

defects.not_fixed_here_because: The wrapper and the cite are both older than this slice, and the three leaves carrying the sentence are already allowlisted with oracle verdicts — rewriting a value three oracles have judged owes three fresh receipts.
defects.resolution: A named follow-on slice: the wrapper stops restating the cite, and the recast citation names the condition that makes the recast live (Syndra's forty-splinter charge), sourced the way a declaration is. Three fresh oracle receipts for the three leaves whose value moves.
